senses.gloss: (b. h.) Lud, Lydia, a district of Asia Minor.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 50a:8">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:6">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הרוגי ל׳</he> the martyrs of L., v. <cite ref="L00204"><he>לוּדְקְיָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 4:5">Tosef. Yeb. IV, 5</cite> (confession of a robber captured in Cappadocia) <he>אני הרגתיו בכניסתו לל׳</he> I killed him on his entering Lydia (Laodicea); Y. ib. II, end, 4ᵇ; Bab.
